verses.sloka: अकम्पनवधं श्रुत्वा क्रुद्धो वै राक्षसेश्वरः ।किञ्चिद्दीनमुखश्चापि सचिवांस्तानुदैक्षत ।। ६.५७.१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: akampanavadhaṁ śrutvā kruddho vai rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।kiñciddīnamukhaścāpi sacivāṁstānudaikṣata ।। 6.57.1 ।।।।

translations.english: The king of Rakshasas hearing about the death of Akampana, was pale and a little angry and looked at his ministers.
translations.hindi: समर में वानरश्रेष्ठी की बदादुरी देख, अकम्पन बहुत क्रुद्ध हुआ

verses.sloka: स तु ध्यात्वा मुहूर्तं तु मन्त्रिभिः संविचार्य च ।ततस्तु रावणः पूर्वदिवसे राक्षसाधिपः ।पुरीं परिययौ लङ्कां सर्वान् गुल्मानवेक्षितुम् ।। ६.५७.२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tu dhyātvā muhūrtaṁ tu mantribhiḥ saṁvicārya ca ।tatastu rāvaṇaḥ pūrvadivase rākṣasādhipaḥ ।purīṁ pariyayau laṅkāṁ sarvān gulmānavekṣitum ।। 6.57.2 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana, the king of Rakshasas, reflected for a while and deliberated with his ministers and proceeded in the forenoon to inspect all posts in Lanka.
translations.hindi: शत्रणां सारथि वाक्यमत्रवस्‌ ॥ जक ने "कोरा और शत्रुओं उसने क्रद्ध हो अपने धनुष का रोदा टंकोरा र की वीरता देख, वह अपने सारथी से कहने लगा

verses.sloka: तां राक्षसगणैर्गुप्तां गुल्मैर्बहुभिरावृताम् ।ददर्श नगरीं लङ्कां पताकाध्वजमालिनीम् ।। ६.५७.३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāṁ rākṣasagaṇairguptāṁ gulmairbahubhirāvṛtām ।dadarśa nagarīṁ laṅkāṁ patākādhvajamālinīm ।। 6.57.3 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana saw Lanka guarded by the Rakshasa army, surrounded by many posts, with flags, posts, and pennants.
translations.hindi: हे सारथे ! तुम तुरन्त मेरा रथ उस जरा पहुँचा दो, जहाँ पर युद्ध में बहुत से वानर बहुत से राक्ष्सों को मार रहे हैं

verses.sloka: रुद्धां तु नगरीं दृष्ट्वा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ।उवाचामर्षतः काले प्रहस्तं युद्धकोविदम् ।। ६.५७.४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ruddhāṁ tu nagarīṁ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।uvācāmarṣataḥ kāle prahastaṁ yuddhakovidam ।। 6.57.4 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana, the Lord of Rakshasas seeing the city besieged, spoke to Prahastha who was skilled in warfare for his welfare.
translations.hindi: जो विपुल-शरीर-घारी वानर वृक्षों और शिलाओं को लिये इए, समर की अभिलाषा से मेरे सामने खड़े हैं, बड़े बल- वान हैं

verses.sloka: पुरस्योपनिविष्टस्य सहसा पीडितस्य वा ।नान्यं युद्धात् प्रपश्यामि मोक्षं युद्धविशारद ।। ६.५७.५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: purasyopaniviṣṭasya sahasā pīḍitasya vā ।nānyaṁ yuddhāt prapaśyāmi mokṣaṁ yuddhaviśārada ।। 6.57.5 ।।।।

translations.english: "I am not able to see anyone (other than you) knowledgeable in warfare to deliver the city oppressed suddenly and can liberate from war."
translations.hindi: अतः समर में वड़ाई चाहने वाला, म इन बलवान बानरों को मारना चाहता हूँ। क्‍योंकि इन्हीं लोगों द्वारा समस्त राक्षसी सेना का नाश होता हुआ देख पड़ता है

verses.sloka: अहं वा कुम्भकर्णो वा त्वं वा सेनापतिर्मम ।इन्द्रजिद्वा निकुम्भो वा वहेयुर्भारमीदृशम् ।। ६.५७.६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ahaṁ vā kumbhakarṇo vā tvaṁ vā senāpatirmama ।indrajidvā nikumbho vā vaheyurbhāramīdṛśam ।। 6.57.6 ।।।।

translations.english: "Either myself or Kumbhakarna, or my CommanderinChief, or you, or Indrajith, or Nikumbha can undertake such a burden."
translations.hindi: , SMU) DE ४५:५१ नता म 4 $ प्रमुखे शरग्रे | ( गो० ) २ प्रजवनाश्वेन- वेगवदश्वेन । ( गो० ) षट्पश्चाशाः सग; ४८६ रथियों ( बीरों ) में श्रेष्ठ अकम्पन, अत्यन्त तेज चलने वाले घोड़ों के रथ में बैठा हुआ और क्रोध में भर, बहुत से बाण छोड़ता हुआ, वानरों को मारने लगा

verses.sloka: स त्वं बलमतः शीघ्रमादाय परिगृह्य च ।विजयायाभिनिर्याहि यत्र सर्वे वनौकसः ।। ६.५७.७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tvaṁ balamataḥ śīghramādāya parigṛhya ca ।vijayāyābhiniryāhi yatra sarve vanaukasaḥ ।। 6.57.7 ।।।।

translations.english: "Therefore, quickly get ready with the army and take charge for conquering the vanaras collected there."
translations.hindi: न स्थात्‌, वानराः शेकुः किं पुनर्थोद्धुमाहवे । अक्म्पनशरे भग्नाः सर्व एव बिदुद्र्वुः ॥ ७ अकम्पन ने उस समय ऐसी म।रकाट मचाई कि, उसके बाण की मार से सब वानर भाग खड़े हुए, उससे युद्ध करना तो एक ओर रहा, उसके सामने भी कोई न खड़ा रह सका

verses.sloka: निर्याणादेव ते नूनं चपला हरिवाहिनी ।नर्दतां राक्षसेन्द्राणां श्रुत्वा नादं द्रविष्यति ।। ६.५७.८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: niryāṇādeva te nūnaṁ capalā harivāhinī ।nardatāṁ rākṣasendrāṇāṁ śrutvā nādaṁ draviṣyati ।। 6.57.8 ।।।।

translations.english: As soon as you go there surely the unsettled Vanara army will run away hearing the uproar and loud noise of Rakshasas.
translations.hindi: परन्तु महाबली हनुमान जी अपनी जाति वाले ( वानरों ) को अकम्पन के वाणों से विवश और मृत्यु के मुख में जाते देख, अकम्पन का सामना कर ने को आगे बढ़े

verses.sloka: चपला ह्यविनीताश्च चलचित्ताश्च वानराः ।न सहिष्यन्ति ते नादं सिंहनादमिव द्विपाः ।। ६.५७.९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: capalā hyavinītāśca calacittāśca vānarāḥ ।na sahiṣyanti te nādaṁ siṁhanādamiva dvipāḥ ।। 6.57.9 ।।।।

translations.english: "Vanaras, who are fickle minded, undisciplined and volatile, will not endure the roar of lions of glowing Rakshasas."

verses.sloka: विद्रुते च बले तस्मिन् रामः सौमित्रिणा सह ।अवशस्ते निरालम्बः प्रहस्त वशमेष्यति ।। ६.५७.१० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vidrute ca bale tasmin rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha ।avaśaste nirālambaḥ prahasta vaśameṣyati ।। 6.57.10 ।।।।

translations.english: "Prahastha! Knowing your strength, the helpless Vanaras will surely run away and along with Saumithri. Rama will fall into your power."
translations.hindi: फल हरे केश बलवान हलुमान जी को अकम्पन का सामना करने को खड़ा होते और और उनका सहारा पा, उन भागे हुए वानर यूथपतियों का उत्साह बढ़ा

verses.sloka: आपत् संशयिता श्रेयो न तु निस्संशयीकृता ।प्रतिलोमानुलोमं वा यद्वा नो मन्यसे हितम् ।। ६.५७.११ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: āpat saṁśayitā śreyo na tu nissaṁśayīkṛtā ।pratilomānulomaṁ vā yadvā no manyase hitam ।। 6.57.11 ।।।।

translations.english: "If uncertain death comes it is good, not when it comes by not encountering. Think what is acceptable to you and what is not acceptable to you and that is acceptable to me."
translations.hindi: अपने सामने पर्वत की तरह अटल अचल हनुमान जी को खड़ा देख, अकम्पन ने उन पर उसी प्रकार वाणवृष्टि की; जिस प्रकार इन्द्र जल की वृष्टि करते हैं

verses.sloka: रावणेनैवमुक्तस्तु प्रहस्तो वाहिनीपतिः ।राक्षसेन्द्रमुवाचेदमसुरेन्द्रमिवोशना ।। ६.५७.१२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇenaivamuktastu prahasto vāhinīpatiḥ ।rākṣasendramuvācedamasurendramivośanā ।। 6.57.12 ।।।।

translations.english: Prahastha, the CommanderinChief having heard Ravana, replied to the king of Rakshasas just as the preceptor of Rakshasas spoke to Bali.

verses.sloka: राजन् मन्त्रितपूर्वं नः कुशलैः सह मन्त्रिभिः ।विवादश्चापि नो वृत्तः समवेक्ष्य परस्परम् ।। ६.५७.१३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rājan mantritapūrvaṁ naḥ kuśalaiḥ saha mantribhiḥ ।vivādaścāpi no vṛttaḥ samavekṣya parasparam ।। 6.57.13 ।।।।

translations.english: "O king! This was deliberated with capable ministers earlier, is it not It was reviewed with one another, and controversy arose."
translations.hindi: वे महातेजस्वी पवननन्दन हनुमान जी प्रथ्वी को कंपाते ओर अट्टहास करते हुए, अकम्पन पर झपटे

verses.sloka: प्रदानेन तु सीतायाः श्रेयो व्यवसितं मया ।अप्रदाने पुनर्युद्धं दृष्टमेतत्तथैव नः ।। ६.५७.१४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: pradānena tu sītāyāḥ śreyo vyavasitaṁ mayā ।apradāne punaryuddhaṁ dṛṣṭametattathaiva naḥ ।। 6.57.14 ।।।।

translations.english: "If Sita is given away it is beneficial and if not given war is foreseen is known to us."
translations.hindi: उश समय सिंहनाद करते हुए और तेज से दीप्यमान पवन- नन्दन ऐसे जान पड़े, मानों दहकती हुई आग हो | उस समय उनका रूप दुधेष हो गया

verses.sloka: सो ऽहं दानैश्च मानैश्च सततं पूजितस्त्वया ।सान्त्वैश्च विविधैः काले किं न कुर्यां प्रियं तव ।। ६.५७.१५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: so 'haṁ dānaiśca mānaiśca satataṁ pūjitastvayā ।sāntvaiśca vividhaiḥ kāle kiṁ na kuryāṁ priyaṁ tava ।। 6.57.15 ।।।।

translations.english: "You have always given me gifts, many honours and praises earlier and worshipped me. When time comes why will I not do"

verses.sloka: न हि मे जीवितं रक्ष्यं पुत्रदारधनानि वा ।त्वं पश्य मां जुहूषन्तं त्वदर्थं जीवितं युधि ।। ६.५७.१६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: na hi me jīvitaṁ rakṣyaṁ putradāradhanāni vā ।tvaṁ paśya māṁ juhūṣantaṁ tvadarthaṁ jīvitaṁ yudhi ।। 6.57.16 ।।।।

translations.english: "I do not need to protect my life, sons, wives and wealth also. I am willing to give up my life also in war for you. You will see."
translations.hindi: बलवान पवननन्दन ने उस पर्वत को एक हाथ में उठा लिआ और उसे घुमाते हुए वे बड़ी जोर से गरजे

verses.sloka: एवमुक्त्वा तु भर्तारं रावणं वाहिनीपतिः ।उवाचेदं बलाध्यक्षान् प्रहस्तः पुरतः स्थितान् ।। ६.५७.१७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā tu bhartāraṁ rāvaṇaṁ vāhinīpatiḥ ।uvācedaṁ balādhyakṣān prahastaḥ purataḥ sthitān ।। 6.57.17 ।।।।

translations.english: Prahastha, having submitted to his king Ravana in that way, the CommanderinChief of the army commanded the army that stood before him.
translations.hindi: उस पर्वत को लिये हुए हनुमान जी उस र।क्षसश्रेछ अकम्पन की ओर वैसे ही दोड़े, जैसे पहिले किसी समय इन्द्र बज लिये हुए नमुचि की ओर दौड़े थे

verses.sloka: समानयत मे शीघ्रं राक्षसानां महद्बलम् ।। ६.५७.१८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: samānayata me śīghraṁ rākṣasānāṁ mahadbalam ।। 6.57.18 ।।।।

translations.english: "Get the great Rakshasa army together with me to the battlefield speedily. By my arrows all the carnivorous birds will be killed and satisfied with the flesh (of Vanaras) today", said Prahastha.

verses.sloka: मद्बाणशतवेगेन हतानां च रणाजिरे ।अद्य तृप्यन्तु मांसादाः पक्षिणः काननौकसाम् ।। ६.५७.१९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: madbāṇaśatavegena hatānāṁ ca raṇājire ।adya tṛpyantu māṁsādāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ kānanaukasām ।। 6.57.19 ।।।।

translations.english: "Get the great Rakshasa army together with me to the battlefield speedily. By my arrows all the carnivorous birds will be killed and satisfied with the flesh (of Vanaras) today", said Prahastha.

verses.sloka: इत्युक्तास्ते प्रहस्तेन बलाध्यक्षाः कृतत्वराः ।बलमुद्योजयामासुस्तस्मिन् राक्षसमन्दिरे ।। ६.५७.२० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ityuktāste prahastena balādhyakṣāḥ kṛtatvarāḥ ।balamudyojayāmāsustasmin rākṣasamandire ।। 6.57.20 ।।।।

translations.english: As soon as the commander in chief ordered in that way, the Rakshasa troops mobilized in the abode of Rakshasas.
translations.hindi: रोष में भरे हुए हनुमान जी ने अश्वकर्ण ( एक प्रकार का शालवृक्ष ) वृक्ष के समीप जा, तुरन्त उसे उखाड़ लिआ। वह अश्वकर्ण वृक्ष एक बड़े पहाड़ की तरह लंबा था

verses.sloka: सा बभूव मुहूर्तेन तिग्मनानाविधायुधैः ।लङ्का राक्षसवीरैस्तैर्गजैरिव समाकुला ।। ६.५७.२१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sā babhūva muhūrtena tigmanānāvidhāyudhaiḥ ।laṅkā rākṣasavīraistairgajairiva samākulā ।। 6.57.21 ।।।।

translations.english: In a short while the whole of Lanka was filled with elephant size Rakshasa warriors gathered with different kinds of weapons.
translations.hindi: महाद्य तिमान इनुमान जी ने युद्धक्षेत्र में उस मोटे तने के अश्वकर्ण को ले कर, परम प्रसन्न हो और अट्टहास करते हुए, उसे घुमाया

verses.sloka: हुताशनं तर्पयतां ब्राह्मणांश्च नमस्यताम् ।आज्यगन्धप्रतिवहः सुरभिर्मारुतो ववौ ।। ६.५७.२२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: hutāśanaṁ tarpayatāṁ brāhmaṇāṁśca namasyatām ।ājyagandhaprativahaḥ surabhirmāruto vavau ।। 6.57.22 ।।।।

translations.english: A fragrant breeze blew past there with Rakshasas propitiating fire god, with offerings and by the worshipping of brahmins the air was pleasant filled with the fragrance of ghee and flowers.

verses.sloka: स्रजश्च विविधाकारा जगृहुस्त्वभिमन्त्रिताः ।सङ्ग्रामसज्जाः संहृष्टा धारयन् राक्षसास्तदा ।। ६.५७.२३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: srajaśca vividhākārā jagṛhustvabhimantritāḥ ।saṅgrāmasajjāḥ saṁhṛṣṭā dhārayan rākṣasāstadā ।। 6.57.23 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the Rakshasas rejoiced, wishing victory, consecrated military material with chanting and wore flower garland s.

verses.sloka: सधनुष्काः कवचिनो वेगादाप्लुत्य राक्षसाः ।रावणं प्रेक्ष्य राजानं प्रहस्तं पर्यवारयन् ।। ६.५७.२४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sadhanuṣkāḥ kavacino vegādāplutya rākṣasāḥ ।rāvaṇaṁ prekṣya rājānaṁ prahastaṁ paryavārayan ।। 6.57.24 ।।।।

translations.english: Wearing bows and shields, looking at and greeting the king Ravana, they swiftly surrounded Prahastha.
translations.hindi: काल की तरह क्रुद्ध और युद्ध में प्राणनाश करने वाले इचु- मान जी को देख, राक्षस योद्धा युद्ध छोड़ भाग खड़े हुए

verses.sloka: अथामन्त्र्य च राजानं भेरीमाहत्य भैरवाम् ।आरुरोह रथं दिव्यं प्रहस्तः सज्जकल्पितम् ।। ६.५७.२५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: athāmantrya ca rājānaṁ bherīmāhatya bhairavām ।āruroha rathaṁ divyaṁ prahastaḥ sajjakalpitam ।। 6.57.25 ।।।।

translations.english: Taking leave of the king and causing terrific sound of blowing of drums, Prahastha, ascended, laughing on to a splendorous chariot, equipped to fight, driven by horses endowed with good speed and capable charioteer, sounding like a thundering cloud, shining like the sun and moon, with a sign of serpent on flag, provided with a wooden fence for defence, which was difficult to collide, covered with gold net.
translations.hindi: राक्षस सेनापति बीर अकम्पन, राक्षसों को भय उपजाने बाले हनुमान जी को अत्यन्त कऋ.द हो आक्रमण करते देख, अत्यन्त क्रू.द्ध हुआ और गर्जा

verses.sloka: हयैर्महाजवैर्युक्तं सम्यक् सूतसुसंयतम् ।महाजलदनिर्घोषं साक्षाच्चन्द्रार्कभास्वरम् ।। ६.५७.२६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: hayairmahājavairyuktaṁ samyak sūtasusaṁyatam ।mahājaladanirghoṣaṁ sākṣāccandrārkabhāsvaram ।। 6.57.26 ।।।।

translations.english: Taking leave of the king and causing terrific sound of blowing of drums, Prahastha, ascended, laughing on to a splendorous chariot, equipped to fight, driven by horses endowed with good speed and capable charioteer, sounding like a thundering cloud, shining like the sun and moon, with a sign of serpent on flag, provided with a wooden fence for defence, which was difficult to collide, covered with gold net.
translations.hindi: उस महाबली अकम्पन ने पैने और शरीर को बिदीण करने वाले १४ बाण हनुमान जी के मार कर, उनको घायल कर दिआ

verses.sloka: उरगध्वजदुर्द्धर्षं सुवरूथं स्वपस्करम् ।सुवर्णजालसंयुक्तं प्रहसन्तमिव श्रिया ।। ६.५७.२७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: uragadhvajadurddharṣaṁ suvarūthaṁ svapaskaram ।suvarṇajālasaṁyuktaṁ prahasantamiva śriyā ।। 6.57.27 ।।।।

translations.english: Taking leave of the king and causing terrific sound of blowing of drums, Prahastha, ascended, laughing on to a splendorous chariot, equipped to fight, driven by horses endowed with good speed and capable charioteer, sounding like a thundering cloud, shining like the sun and moon, with a sign of serpent on flag, provided with a wooden fence for defence, which was difficult to collide, covered with gold net.
translations.hindi: बहुत से बाणों की वृष्टि से घायल होने पर, वीर हनुमान जी वृक्षों से युक्त एक गिरश्शज्ञ की तरह देख पड़ते थे

verses.sloka: ततस्तं रथमास्थाय रावणार्पितशासनः ।लङ्काया निर्ययौ तूर्णं बलेन महता वृतः ।। ६.५७.२८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastaṁ rathamāsthāya rāvaṇārpitaśāsanaḥ ।laṅkāyā niryayau tūrṇaṁ balena mahatā vṛtaḥ ।। 6.57.28 ।।।।

translations.english: Then, by the order of Ravana, Prahastha set out immediately and departed from Lanka taking a se at in the chariot, surrounded by the great army.
translations.hindi: महाकाय, महाबलवान्‌ और महामना हनुमान जी उस समया वैसे शोभायमान दो रहे थे, जैसे फूला हुआ अशोक का उक्त अथ ८ बिना घुएँ की ( घधकती हुई ) आग

verses.sloka: ततो दुन्दुभिनिर्घोषः पर्जन्यनिनदोपमः ।वादित्राणां च निनदः पूरयन्निव सागरम् ।शुश्रुवे शङ्खशब्दश्च प्रयाते वाहिनीपतौ ।। ६.५७.२९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato dundubhinirghoṣaḥ parjanyaninadopamaḥ ।vāditrāṇāṁ ca ninadaḥ pūrayanniva sāgaram ।śuśruve śaṅkhaśabdaśca prayāte vāhinīpatau ।। 6.57.29 ।।।।

translations.english: As the CommanderinChief was going there arose sounds of kettle drums, blasts of fanfares, and noise of blasts of conchs filling the earth was heard.

verses.sloka: निनदन्तः स्वरान् घोरान् राक्षसा जग्मुरग्रतः ।भीमरूपा महाकायाः प्रहस्तस्य पुरस्सराः ।। ६.५७.३० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ninadantaḥ svarān ghorān rākṣasā jagmuragrataḥ ।bhīmarūpā mahākāyāḥ prahastasya purassarāḥ ।। 6.57.30 ।।।।

translations.english: Rakshasas of fierce appearance, of huge body size, making dreadful sounds went marching ahead of Prahastha.
translations.hindi: क्रोध से पूर्ण, महाबली एवं वानरश्रेष्ठ हनुमान जी द्वारा वृक्ष के प्रहार से घायल हो, वह राक्षेस उसी चण प्रथ्बी पर गिर कर सर गया

verses.sloka: नरान्तकः कुम्भहनुर्महानादः समुन्नतः ।प्रहस्तसचिवा ह्येते निर्ययुः परिवार्य तम् ।। ६.५७.३१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: narāntakaḥ kumbhahanurmahānādaḥ samunnataḥ ।prahastasacivā hyete niryayuḥ parivārya tam ।। 6.57.31 ।।।।

translations.english: Naranthaka, Kumbhahanu, Mahanada, Samunnatha, the adjutants of Prahastha went with him.
translations.hindi: राक्षेसश्रेष्ठ अकम्पन को जमीन पर मरा हुआ पड़ा देख, उसकी सेना के अन्य राक्षेस योद्धा वैसे ही व्यथित हो थरी उठ, जैसे भूकम्प होने पर इत्ते थरा उठते हैं

verses.sloka: व्यूढेनैव सुघोरेण पूर्वद्वारात् स निर्ययौ ।गजयूथनिकाशेन बलेन महता वृतः ।। ६.५७.३२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vyūḍhenaiva sughoreṇa pūrvadvārāt sa niryayau ।gajayūthanikāśena balena mahatā vṛtaḥ ।। 6.57.32 ।।।।

translations.english: He, emerged from the eastern gate, surrounded by a huge, formidable army formed into a battlearray, which resembled a herd of elephants.
translations.hindi: उन पराजित राक्षर्सा ने अपने अपने हथियार पटक दिये और बानरों द्वारा खदेड़े जा कर, वे भयभीत हो लङ्का की ओर भाग गए

verses.sloka: सागरप्रतिमौघेन वृतस्तेन बलेन सः ।प्रहस्तो निर्ययौ तूर्णं कालान्तकयमोपमः ।। ६.५७.३३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sāgarapratimaughena vṛtastena balena saḥ ।prahasto niryayau tūrṇaṁ kālāntakayamopamaḥ ।। 6.57.33 ।।।।

translations.english: Prahastha emerged in rage surrounded by his forces which was like an ocean that resembled Kala (time spirit), Anthaka (death) and Yama (God of death).
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार भागते समय उन राक्तंसों की बड़ी दुर्गति हो रही. थी। उनके [सर के बाल बिखर गए थे। उस समय घबड़ाए हुए | ठ्ठ त्त्य ७ 0 गर, होने के कारण और हार जाने के कारण उनका सान भङ्गहो चुका था। उनके शरीरों से पसीना टपक रहा था और दे हाँफते हुए भागे जा रहे थे

verses.sloka: तस्य निर्याणघोषेण राक्षसानां च नर्दताम् ।लङ्कायां सर्वभूतानि विनेदुर्विकृतैः स्वरैः ।। ६.५७.३४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya niryāṇaghoṣeṇa rākṣasānāṁ ca nardatām ।laṅkāyāṁ sarvabhūtāni vinedurvikṛtaiḥ svaraiḥ ।। 6.57.34 ।।।।

translations.english: By the sounds of roaring that emerged at the departure of the Rakshasas all beings of Lanka shrieked in unnatural ways.
translations.hindi: वे सारे डर के आपस में एक दूसरे से लटपटाते किसी तरह लङ्का में पहुँचे । किन्तु सागते समय भी वे बार बार फिर फिर कर अपने पीछे हनुमान जी को देखते जाते थे

verses.sloka: व्यभ्रमाकाशमाविश्य मांसशोणितभोजनाः ।मण्डलान्यपसव्यानि खगाश्चक्रू रथं प्रति ।। ६.५७.३५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vyabhramākāśamāviśya māṁsaśoṇitabhojanāḥ ।maṇḍalānyapasavyāni khagāścakrū rathaṁ prati ।। 6.57.35 ।।।।

translations.english: The birds living on flesh and blood reached the sky and circled anticlockwise around the chariot.
translations.hindi: उन महाबली राक्षसा के भाग कर लङ्का में घुस जाने पर, सब वानरों ने एकत्र हो (अर्थात्‌ एक स्वर से ) हनुमान जी की प्रशंशा की

verses.sloka: वमन्त्यः पावकज्वालाः शिवा घोरं ववाशिरे ।अन्तरिक्षात् पपातोल्का वायुश्च परुषो ववौ ।। ६.५७.३६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vamantyaḥ pāvakajvālāḥ śivā ghoraṁ vavāśire ।antarikṣāt papātolkā vāyuśca paruṣo vavau ।। 6.57.36 ।।।।

translations.english: A meteor fell from the sky, the wind blew violently. Jackals howled vomiting tongues of fire.
translations.hindi: बलवान्‌ हनुमान जीने भी परम प्रसन्न हो, उन सब बानरों से कहा कि, आप ही लोगों की सहायता से मने यह विजय पाया है । फिर उन्होंने बानरों को गले लगा आर उनके साथ यथा योग्य बातचीत कर उनको उत्साहित किआ

verses.sloka: अन्योन्यमभिसंरब्धा ग्रहाश्च न चकाशिरे ।। ६.५७.३७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: anyonyamabhisaṁrabdhā grahāśca na cakāśire ।। 6.57.37 ।।।।

translations.english: The planets clashing with one another did not shine. The clouds were violent like donkeys and rained blood on top of the chariot and the marching Rakshasas drenched.

verses.sloka: मेघाश्च खरनिर्घोषा रथस्योपरि रक्षसः ।ववृषू रुधिरं चास्य सिषिचुश्च पुरस्सरान् ।। ६.५७.३८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: meghāśca kharanirghoṣā rathasyopari rakṣasaḥ ।vavṛṣū rudhiraṁ cāsya siṣicuśca purassarān ।। 6.57.38 ।।।।

translations.english: The planets clashing with one another did not shine. The clouds were violent like donkeys and rained blood on top of the chariot and the marching Rakshasas drenched.
translations.hindi: जिस प्रकार भगवान्‌ विष्णु, महाभयङ्कर एवं रात्र्‌ हन्ता ( मधु केटभादि ) बढ़े बड़े असुरों को मार कर, शोभायमान हुए थे, उसी प्रकार पवननन्दन हनुमान जो राक्षसों को मार वीरो- चित शोभा से शोभायमान हुए

verses.sloka: केतुमूर्धनि गृध्रो ऽस्य निलीनो दक्षिणामुखः ।तुदन्नुभयतः पार्श्वं समग्रामहरत् प्रभाम् ।। ६.५७.३९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ketumūrdhani gṛdhro 'sya nilīno dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ।tudannubhayataḥ pārśvaṁ samagrāmaharat prabhām ।। 6.57.39 ।।।।

translations.english: Seeing a vulture sitting on the banner (of Prahastha) facing south scratching both sides, Prahastha became pale as if the entire prosperity had been snatched away.

verses.sloka: सारथेर्बहुशश्चास्य सङ्ग्राममवगाहतः ।प्रतोदो न्यपतद्धस्तात् सूतस्य हयसादिनः ।। ६.५७.४० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sāratherbahuśaścāsya saṅgrāmamavagāhataḥ ।pratodo nyapataddhastāt sūtasya hayasādinaḥ ।। 6.57.40 ।।।।

translations.english: A charioteer and knower of controlling the horses, the whip slipped many times from his hand.

verses.sloka: निर्याणश्रीश्च या ऽस्यासीद्भास्वरा वसुदुर्लभा ।सा ननाश मुहूर्तेन समे च स्खलिता हयाः ।। ६.५७.४१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: niryāṇaśrīśca yā 'syāsīdbhāsvarā vasudurlabhā ।sā nanāśa muhūrtena same ca skhalitā hayāḥ ।। 6.57.41 ।।।।

translations.english: The splendour of Prahastha which is difficult to destroy, disappeared at that moment and the horses stumbled on even ground.

verses.sloka: प्रहस्तं त्वभिनिर्यान्तं प्रख्यातबलपौरुषम् ।युधि नानाप्रहरणा कपिसेना ऽभ्यवर्तत ।। ६.५७.४२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: prahastaṁ tvabhiniryāntaṁ prakhyātabalapauruṣam ।yudhi nānāpraharaṇā kapisenā 'bhyavartata ।। 6.57.42 ।।।।

translations.english: Seeing Prahastha, who is well known for his valour coming towards, for war with various weapons, the monkey army stood facing.

verses.sloka: अथ घोषः सुतुमुलो हरीणां समजायत ।वृक्षानारुजतां चैव गुर्वीरागृह्णतां शिलाः ।। ६.५७.४३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: atha ghoṣaḥ sutumulo harīṇāṁ samajāyata ।vṛkṣānārujatāṁ caiva gurvīrāgṛhṇatāṁ śilāḥ ।। 6.57.43 ।।।।

translations.english: And when the monkeys took hold of heavy rocks and trees for fighting exceedingly tumultuous clamor arose.

verses.sloka: नदतां राक्षसानां च वानराणां च गर्जताम् ।उभे प्रमुदिते सैन्ये रक्षोगणवनौकसाम् ।। ६.५७.४४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nadatāṁ rākṣasānāṁ ca vānarāṇāṁ ca garjatām ।ubhe pramudite sainye rakṣogaṇavanaukasām ।। 6.57.44 ।।।।

translations.english: The yelling noise of Rakshasas and roaring noise of Vanaras of both armies, who were powerful and seized with speed, who sought the destruction of one another, challenging noises of Rakshasas and Vanaras, highly rejoiced, was heard.

verses.sloka: वेगितानां समर्थानामन्योन्यवधकाङ्क्षिणाम् ।परस्परं चाह्वयतां निनादः श्रूयते महान् ।। ६.५७.४५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vegitānāṁ samarthānāmanyonyavadhakāṅkṣiṇām ।parasparaṁ cāhvayatāṁ ninādaḥ śrūyate mahān ।। 6.57.45 ।।।।

translations.english: The yelling noise of Rakshasas and roaring noise of Vanaras of both armies, who were powerful and seized with speed, who sought the destruction of one another, challenging noises of Rakshasas and Vanaras, highly rejoiced, was heard.

verses.sloka: ततः प्रहस्तः कपिराजवाहिनीमभिप्रतस्थे विजयाय दुर्मतिः ।विवृद्धवेगां च विवेश तां चमूं यथा मुमूर्षुः शलभो विभावसुम् ।। ६.५७.४६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prahastaḥ kapirājavāhinīmabhipratasthe vijayāya durmatiḥ ।vivṛddhavegāṁ ca viveśa tāṁ camūṁ yathā mumūrṣuḥ śalabho vibhāvasum ।। 6.57.46 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, perverted Prahastha entered into that army of monkey king grown immensely, to conquer the army, just as moth enters into flame, being at the point of death. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेसप्तपञ्चाशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the fifty seventh sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
